attempts.summary: Configured /etc/logrotate.d/inventory on node1 to rotate /var/log/inventory/app.log daily, keep 7 compressed rotations, and use copytruncate so the application (which has no reload/signal hook available) can keep writing to the same file path uninterrupted. Validated with logrotate -d (dry run) and a forced rotation showing immediate .gz compression and continued writes. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id, issued sudo shutdown -r now, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified the logrotate config, rotated archive, and live write capability post-restart.
